column3: A request carrying a forwarding or client-address header (an extended list and name pattern, best-effort) never counts as a trusted source; BootUI has no such denial and reads the servlet remote address; extends the sharpit forwarded-header rule

Request paths of HTTP exchanges, exception records and security logs mask matrix parameters as BootUI UriMasking.maskPath does (a sensitive name or a secret-shaped value) when secret masking is on; under METADATA_ONLY every matrix value is masked with secret masking on or off (stricter than BootUI); FULL is untouched, where BootUI still masks credential-carrying values; the decoded ASGI path is used; trace and journal paths keep masking every matrix value
